title: Blender 5.2 rejects BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT render-engine enum
symptom: Scene build stopped before artifact creation with TypeError because BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT was not in the local enum set.
expected_behavior: Use the actual installed Blender 5.2 render engine identifier.
actual_behavior: Installed Blender exposed BLENDER_EEVEE, BLENDER_WORKBENCH and CYCLES.
proposed_fix: Use BLENDER_EEVEE for the installed 5.2.1 LTS provider.
fix_attempt: Changed one enum value and repeated the original build plus GLB round trip.
verification: Build rendered PNG, saved .blend, exported GLB, and independent Blender import passed.
